cohort: 1,021,268 term singleton pregnancies without congenital anomalies or antepartum stillbirths in Norway
finding: Despite increases in maternal and obstetric risk factors, term intrapartum stillbirth rates substantially decreased from 1999 to 2018, potentially due to improvements in intrapartum care.
mod_finding: Three in four term intrapartum stillbirths occurred during intrapartum operative deliveries.
